title: EU chief says 'this is no time to withdraw' Ukraine support

blocks.text: BRUSSELS, Belgium—European Union (EU) chief Antonio Costa believes it is time to raise the pressure on Russia and support for Kyiv, rallying behind Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelensky as tensions spike with Washington. “This is no time to withdraw the support to Ukraine. This is no time to relieve Russia’s sanctions,” Costa told reporters flanked by Zelensky as they arrived on Friday at a summit of EU leaders in Brussels. “Now it is time to increase our support, to increase our pressure,” the EU head said. /apl...
